name: opencore-picker-theme
description: 配置、制作与排错 OpenCore 的图形启动选择器（OpenCanopy）主题：图标集、PickerAttributes 属性位、Flavour 系统、标签、位图字体、音频辅助、背景图与 HiDPI。含必需图标清单与尺寸、官方图标集缺哪些可选图标的权威对照，以及 Resources 树合规检查脚本。
description_en: Configure, build and troubleshoot the OpenCore graphical boot picker (OpenCanopy) theme: icon sets, PickerAttributes, the flavour system, labels, bitmap fonts, audio assist, background image and HiDPI. Includes the mandatory-icon list with dimensions, which optional icons the official icon sets do NOT ship, and a Resources-tree compliance checker.
